text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka and I are visiting a shrine.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been feeling so hot lately... I
figure
praying at a shrine every now and
then couldn't
hurt.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the thought of relying on
others
was always pretty lame to me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But in this delinquent manga I'm
reading...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When the main character took on the
leader of
another school's gang, his
friends went to a shrine
and prayed for
his victory.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even though they usually do their talkin'
with
their fists, they got all serious and
prayed for him.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It may not show in how they usually
speak or act,
but they've got feelings to
share too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
When I read that... I couldn't help but
get all fired
up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh... Right?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to make the coolest
prayer ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to pray for Vodka's condition to

improve.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I think I nailed it with that prayer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I prayed for my parents, for everyone in
the
dorm... and I prayed for you too!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa. I'm suddenly bursting with
energy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeahhh! I'm just itchin' to run! I've
gotta kick it
into high gear!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, does this energy mean... you
prayed for
me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I saw you prayin' real hard next to me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
How about that. Guess I've gotta thank
ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there were good things to
be gained
by coming here. Vodka's
spirits are soaring high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to pray for success as Vodka's
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So this is what prayin' at a shrine's like!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Next time we come, I'm gonna really pray for you! Make sure you're prepared!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Anyway, should we head ba—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Augh? What're they doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow Vodka's line of sight to a flirty
couple.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Agh! M-my nose is bleeding! And my...
face is
burning?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I came here to feel better! I can't believe this is happening... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's nosebleed goes on seemingly
forever,
and she ends up tuckered out...
